# Basic support and separate services — draft

Status: DRAFT, pending commercial approval and a real support channel.

Included for twelve months: clarification of the shipped installation and
configuration guides, triage of reproducible template defects in an acquired
release, and guidance for entitled release updates and documented migrations.
Support requests should include a release ID, sanitized reproduction and relevant
non-secret logs. Do not send credentials or production customer data.

Separately scoped and priced: custom design/branding implementation, new business
features, bespoke integrations, data migrations beyond shipped tooling, deployment
execution, infrastructure operation and project-specific performance work.
The customer can use the shipped customization skills independently; buying
services is not required to retain or run acquired code.

Pending approval: the support contact channel, coverage hours, supported release
window, escalation/response commitments, service quote/rate terms and exclusions.
No SLA or guarantee of a third party's service is made by this draft. Expiry ends
future included support and updates, while acquired files remain accessible.
